observations.finding: The original M2 run and M3 follow-up are historical reports with their own binary/dirty-state context and differing controls. They do not estimate this packet prior or likelihoods.

A reread, reformatted receipt or new summary of a report is not a new experimental trial. Different actual trials can produce equal summaries; report hash or wrapper ID alone does not establish the independence model.
All authored losses, test costs and migration charges use the same declared cardinal teaching scale. They are not measurements in milliseconds, dollars or engineering minutes.
The pinned agentic guide motivates scoped work and review efficiency. Its recommendations and historical model claims do not calibrate current performance or prove exchangeability.
